scope: Pre-generation review of exact requirements and design checkpoint, not approval of rendered or working deliverables.
passed_design_intent: All three requested route families are named and source/proposal status is preserved.
Storage low sleeves/cassettes and internal short transfers are explicitly new; center aisle and old facade features preserved.
Manual zones and the finite automation scope are explicit.
Raw fish and cooked fish are separated; warmth furnace excluded from food/smelting; permitted raw-resource sales are retained.
Full downstream, per-slot reservation, exclusive transfer ownership and no automatic store-in/store-out loop are defined.
Dual-input assembly route acknowledges original A56.5–59s observations without freezing recipes.
Normal/full states and multiple actual render views are required, with independent review and failed candidates retained.

required_clarifications.item: Add explicit dual-input assembler connection study or provide equivalent visible coverage in another study. Separate typed ingredient magazines/input ports; output has its own buffer. New Havenline machine geometry remains a proposal.
Utility cassette must address timber vs mineral bay selection: bounded per-class local trays or exclusive typed batch operation. No single mixed pile reaches all shelves by invisible transport.
Render visible wrong-item/reject or source-held incompatible carrier state, not only normal/full. Show finite stop/reject behavior without deletion.
Reserve illustrated perimeter space behind and beside storage for rear/left cassettes and service access; no attachments inside fence or obstruction of the two gate corridors.

nonblocking_precision_notes: A future compatible workstation endpoint is a reserved planned socket until an input catalogue/recipe is established; do not show an unsupported active conversion.
D01/D02 multi-angle geometry must include transfer surfaces and stop gates rather than bury them under headings.
Per-slot reservation on concept art is a system proposal, not a claim the original advertisement uses that engine algorithm.
Any finite illustrated slot count is concept staging and does not set balance capacity.
pending_evidence: Final typed route table and exact spatial/vector plan
Seven/equivalent selected render studies and their interface/full/reject views
Complete declared source inspection inventory and additional research
approval_boundary: No mandatory output check is waived. All final candidate images remain unreviewed at this checkpoint.
